messages.text:
I’m continuing the comparison pass now, including tree and sort behavior.

The long-view column spacing matching on the first pass is a nice sign, but tree depth and multi-directory cases still need checking.

commands.commandLine:
"C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command "@'
import subprocess, pathlib
ref=pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip(); exe=str(pathlib.Path('executable.cmd').resolve())
cases=[
 ['--long','--no-user','--no-time','--no-filesize','rust-reference/tests/itest','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['--tree','rust-reference/tests/itest','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['--tree','--level=2','rust-reference/tests/itest','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['--sort=size','rust-reference/tests/itest','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['--reverse','rust-reference/tests/itest','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['--long','--header','tmp_probe','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['--only-dirs','tmp_probe','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['--only-files','tmp_probe','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['-a','tmp_probe','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['-aa','tmp_probe','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['tmp_probe','rust-reference/tests/itest','--color=never','--icons=never'],
]
for args in cases:
 r=subprocess.run([ref,*args],capture_output=True); p=subprocess.run([exe,*args],capture_output=True)
 ok=(r.returncode==p.returncode and r.stdout==p.stdout and r.stderr==p.stderr)
 print('OK' if ok else 'DIFF', args, r.returncode, p.returncode, len(r.stdout), len(p.stdout))
 if not ok:
  print('REF OUT', r.stdout[:1000].decode('utf-8','replace'))
  print('PY OUT', p.stdout[:1000].decode('utf-8','replace'))
  print('REF ERR', r.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace'))
  print('PY ERR', p.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace'))
  break
'@ | python -"
